statements.subject: connection
statements.description: A control connection SHOULD be closed by closing the underlying TCP connection under the following circumstances:

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: If a control connection is not in the established state (i.e., Start-Control-Connection-Request and Start-Control-Connection-Reply have not been exchanged), a control connection SHOULD be closed after 60 seconds by a peer waiting for a Start-Control-Connection-Request or Start-Control-Connection-Reply message.
statements.pre_cond: connection.state != established & (Start-Control-Connection-Request.received = false | Start-Control-Connection-Reply.received = false) & timer.elapsed >= 60
actions: close control connection by closing underlying TCP connection

statements.subject: peer
statements.description: If a peer's control connection is in the established state and has not received a control message for 60 seconds, it SHOULD send a Echo-Request message.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: If an Echo-Reply is not received 60 seconds after the Echo-Request message transmission, the control connection SHOULD be closed.
statements.pre_cond: connection.state = established & Echo-Request.sent = true & Echo-Reply.received = false & timer.echo_elapsed >= 60
actions: close control connection by closing underlying TCP connection
